youtube.description:
Hello little kits! I am MommyVixen, Prismatic Kitsune, Goddess of light. I am a variety streamer and transwoman just trying to make a place where people can feel loved, feel safe, and feel appreciated. I currently only stream on Twitch (my pc can't handle multistreaming at the moment) The content I currently post is directly from my streams, so if you enjoy my content, please consider following on twitch! 
I work a full time job, and stream as a hobby. I unfortunately dont have time to make long form content, but im hoping to change that soon!
